refusal.initialization: zero all slots before launch and inspect every slot after synchronization

aliases: primal arrays, incoming output seed, accumulated input cotangents, topology transpose, workspace and failure storage mutually disjoint; omega tangent is in-place
math: f32, no contraction, no hardware flush-to-zero; native helper protects IEEE subnormals
status: reconciled contracts; current proof results are recorded in the receipt
branch_record_status: captured-state sign records are stable on the fixed section 87 Taylor mask; positive and negative arms, signed-zero arms, and full-state crossing are separately recorded as diagnostics. Masked-out elements are reported as crossing-only, not as one-sided grades. Uncalled helper predicates are false-candidates.
abi_status: ordered bindings; overwritten output cotangents are inout and cleared
adjoint_seed_lifetime: Output cotangent seed buffers are writable and separate from the accumulated input cotangents. Each overwritten output slot is zeroed after use; untouched output slots retain their incoming value.

taylor_mask.predicate: sign bit read by mpas_copysign at tree/src/hexcore/cuda_acoustic.py:145
taylor_mask.construction: Before evaluating any Taylor error, keep every element that cannot feed the sign predicate. For the remaining elements, keep the original seeded direction only when the sign is unchanged at both float32 perturbations at epsilon 0.1. Determine predicate reach from the captured n_edges_on_cell and edges_on_cell topology, using levels 1 through nlev-1 and skipping invalid edges as the forward does. Record the mask and topology map with their SHA-256 values, and verify each predicate operand at all seven epsilons.
taylor_mask.masked_out: Report as crossing-only using the unmasked full-state direction; exercise the positive and negative arms separately.
